'''Basic Fertilizer''' is a [[Fertilizer]] that helps by improving soil quality. It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from [[Pierre's General Store]] for {{Price|100}} starting on [[Spring]] 15th of year 1. <ref name="unlock" />

Basic Fertilizer must be placed on tilled soil ''before'' a seed has sprouted.

Basic Fertilizer affects only the basic harvest, which means that extra crops gained at a single harvest (''i.e.,'' [[Coffee Bean]], [[Blueberry]], [[Cranberries]]) will be regular quality.

==Bundles==
Basic Fertilizer is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Basic Fertilizer can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|High-Waisted Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt174.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Basic Fertilizer is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Basic Fertilizer can be applied to seeds (but can't be applied once a seed has sprouted).  Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
